label: Google Pixel 9 Pro smartphone
description: Tensor G4 phone. Cellular is 5G sub-6 plus mmWave on the GR83Y SKU: sub-6 n1/n2/n3/n5/n7/n8/n12/n14/n20/n25/n26/n28/n29/n30/n38/n40/n41/n48/n66/n70/n71/n77/n78 and mmWave n258/n260/n261; the GGX8B SKU is sub-6 only. Wi-Fi is 7 (802.11be) on 2.4 + 5 + 6 GHz with 2x2 + 2x2 MIMO. Radios: one wlan (Wi-Fi 7) and one wwan (5G); charging and data are USB-C only, so there is no RJ45.
notes: Google's own spec sheet splits the two 5G SKUs by band table, which is why the mmWave claim is tied to GR83Y rather than to the model name. No Ethernet: Pixel phones have never carried an RJ45 and this one has no dock NIC either. Satellite SOS is not modelled as an interface.
